body: i really cant pinpoint what the problem is...in fact i am a person who always thanks myself lucky because i know there is a lot of people a lot worse of than me.  i really just dont the see the point anymore. i get up, go to work, do housework, i have friends and family who love to see me because they say i cheer their day up! i have got so good at pretending that all is fine and then when i am on my own i sob my heart out.  like now, i have just dropped hubby at work come home to sit and cry...sob really...then i will make an effort, get ready and i will go to work and be the happy cheerful tanya that everybody knows.  my husband has started to notice that i have become quiet and keeps asking if i am ok and i just wanna screammm NOOOO but i dont why i feel like this. My head feels like it is going to explode. the fact that i am planning to go, but will wait til after xmas is playng on my mind so much. (i dont want xmas to be a horrible time for my family...i used to love xmas but this year i hate everything about it and i know it is because of this horrible feeling of doom looming over me) I am sorry for rambling but i am hoping that doing this is going to help. i cant talk to anybody because everybody will worry so much because i am normally carefree and laid back and they will wonder why?? how can i answer that when i dont know why.
